* Own end-to-end complaint management for international and domestic customers (acknowledgement, resolution timelines, investigation, closure) through a structured tracking system covering quality, breakage, defects, shortages, packaging, labelling, documentation and shipment delays.
* Coordinate RCA and CAPA with the concerned departments, ensure timely and accurate investigation reports, and hold periodic review meetings with departmental heads to drive accountability and feed lessons learned into SOPs and improvements in quality, packaging, documentation and delivery reliability.

* Monitor shipping costs (freight, demurrage, detention) and optimise shipment planning and container utilisation.

* Present periodic MIS and dashboards to management (order status and backlog, on-time shipments, complaints with RCA/CAPA status, shipment status, documentation accuracy, freight and avoidable costs, export proceeds, team productivity), analyse trends and close process gaps.

* MBA / PGDM in International Business, Operations or Supply Chain (added advantage).
* Certification in Export-Import Management, International Trade or Logistics (preferred).

**Experience**

* 10-15 years in international sales coordination, export commercial operations, customer services or EXIM management, including international customer handling, export documentation, shipment coordination and complaint resolution.
* 3-5 years leading teams or managing multiple functions.
* Experience coordinating with international buyers, freight forwarders, customs brokers, shipping lines and financial institutions.
* Experience in ceramic, porcelain, tableware, homeware or another export-oriented manufacturing organisation (preferred).

* Strong team leadership and people management.
* Excellent written and verbal business English.
* Customer orientation, stakeholder management, cross-functional collaboration and conflict resolution.
* Analytical thinking, structured problem-solving and decision-making.
* Attention to detail, accuracy and compliance discipline.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, tight deadlines and customer escalations.

Kandla Special Economic Zone (KASEZ), Gandhidham, Gujarat

**About the Company**

**Founded in 1985, Recycle Plastics is an established pioneer in sustainable polymer manufacturing and waste recovery, dedicated to driving the circular economy. Operating advanced recycling facilities equipped with special authorizations from the Government of India, the company processes high-grade recycled polymers and authorized imported raw materials from Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia. Under the leadership of Founder and Managing Director Mr. Rakesh Aggarwal, Recycle Plastics actively partners with urban local bodies (ULBs) and multinational corporations across Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) frameworks and plastic credit mechanisms to eliminate landfill waste.**

**Role Overview**

**We are looking for a detail-driven and experienced Assistant Manager EXIM & Banking Documentation**
to join our manufacturing and processing unit at the
**Kandla Special Economic Zone (KASEZ)**
.

In this role, you will lead the end-to-end management of import/export trade paperwork, customs documentation, and trade finance banking operations. You will act as the operational bridge between plant logistics, customs authorities, banks, customs house agents (CHAs), and internal finance teams to ensure zero demurrage, complete regulatory compliance, and seamless cross-border transactions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Export & Import Documentation**

* Prepare, audit, and finalise pre- and post-shipment documents: Commercial Invoices, Packing Lists, Bills of Lading (BL), Certificates of Origin (COO), and declarations.
* Oversee import clearances of raw materials arriving at Kandla / Mundra ports, ensuring prompt filing and assessment of Bills of Entry (BOE).
* Coordinate export consignments, including Shipping Bills, factory-stuffing permissions, and container movement to port terminals.
* Coordinate with Custom House Agents (CHAs), freight forwarders, and shipping lines for vessel bookings, container tracking, and delivery orders.

**2. SEZ Online & Regulatory Compliance**

* Manage day-to-day operations on the
  **SEZ Online portal**
  (Bill of Entry, DTA procurement/sales, Sub-contracting challans, and SEZ-to-SEZ transfers).
* Ensure strict adherence to KASEZ customs guidelines, SEZ Act & Rules, foreign trade policy (FTP), and relevant clearance permissions.
* Maintain comprehensive registers for bonding, debonding, material inward/outward reconciliation, and assist in preparation for periodic SEZ/Customs audits.

**3. Banking & Trade Finance Paperwork**

* Handle all international trade banking paperwork, including inward and outward remittances (Advance Payments, Direct Remittances, and Open Account trade).
* Manage the application, vetting, submission, and retirement of import/export
  **Letters of Credit (LCs)**
  and
  **Bank Guarantees (BGs)**
  .
* Oversee regulatory trade compliance portals:
  **EDPMS**
  (export tracking/e-BRC generation) and
  **IDPMS**
  (import payment knock-offs and BOE settlement) to prevent RBI/EDPMS cautionary listings.
* Interface with partner banks trade finance desks to resolve documentation discrepancies, track forward exchange contracts, and negotiate transactional charges.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Commerce (B.Com / M.Com), International Trade, Supply Chain, or Business Administration. A diploma/certification in Foreign Trade / EXIM is a strong advantage.
* **Experience:**
  3 to 6 years of hands-on experience in import-export documentation, trade finance banking, and customs clearance ideally within an SEZ manufacturing environment (Kandla / Mundra region preferred).
* **Technical Proficiency:**
* **Hands-on working knowledge of SEZ Online**
  and
  **ICEGATE**
  .
* Thorough operational understanding of
  **IDPMS, EDPMS, and DGFT portals**
  .
* Familiarity with ERP software (SAP / Tally) and advanced MS Excel.
* **Domain Knowledge:**
  Firm grasp of Incl terms 2020, customs tariff heads (HS codes), FEMA guidelines for trade credit, and UCP 600 rules for Letters of Credit.
* **Core Competencies:**
  High attention to procedural detail, strong communication skills for multi-stakeholder management (customs, banks, overseas suppliers), and proactive problem-solving.

**Why Join Us?**

* Be an integral part of an industry leader shaping circular economy solutions and sustainable polymer supply chains in India.
* Dynamic work environment with high autonomy in international trade operations.
* Competitive compensation aligned with industry standards and regional expertise.

The Sr. Manager – Industrial Engineering owns the Industrial Engineering function across all Group Bayport plants and processes — printing, stitching, cutting, and across the Covers & All (outdoor furniture covers, cushions) and BannerBuzz (banners, signage & displays) product lines. + Introduce Poka-Yoke / mistake-proofing where scrap or quality leakage is systemic rather than one-off.

+ Partner with MDM Team for BOM Preparation for Time Measurement (Crue member size/labour/machine).

title: Manager - Process Excellence & Cost Optimization
description:
**Job Purpose**
This role controls plant cost and material loss and improves workforce productivity. It does this through standard measurement systems (BOM, cost per sq ft, manpower matrices) and shop-floor automation such as production scanning, smart scheduling and live dashboards.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Cost and Financial Control**

* Track monthly plant cost per sq ft against budget, and analyse and explain variances.
* Reconcile BB and COV material consumption and wastage against BOM, keeping variance within 1%.
* Build and maintain a BOM-based tracking system for general consumables, with cost variance within 5%.
* Reconcile and approve job-worker bills within the agreed billing cycle, with no delays.

**Automation and Digital Tracking**

* Implement operator-wise and team-wise production scanning (barcode for COV, QR code for BB) to measure throughput and reduce manpower cost by 10% YoY.
* Drive smart production scheduling and order-kit allocation to improve direct-worker efficiency by 20%.
* Develop an AI / Power BI tracker for media-wise material inflow versus wastage, with full traceability and variance under 1%.
* Maintain daily plant and department dashboards comparing budget and actual cost trends.

**Waste Management and Manpower Productivity**

* Develop at least two alternate or backup buyers for each saleable scrap item or category, targeting a 15% impact on sale value.
* Optimise waste disposal, including balers for cardboard, plastic and fabric, to cut waste volume by 30%.
* Build a manpower performance measurement matrix for non-sq-ft production and non-production departments.
* Support the skill matrix and skill-based operator allocation, and train supervisors and operators in method and productivity improvement (10 people per department).

**General Duties**

* Conduct time and motion studies, set standard times, and balance lines.
* Prepare monthly MIS and variance reports for management.
* Coordinate with production, stores, finance, IT and vendors.
* Lead Lean, Kaizen and 5S initiatives.

**Qualifications And Experience**

* B.E./B.Tech in Industrial, Mechanical or Production Engineering. An MBA or PGDIE is preferred.
* 8–12 years in manufacturing industrial engineering, costing or productivity, including at least 3 years leading projects or a team.

**Skills And Competencies**

* Strong in BOM and inventory reconciliation, cost analysis, time study and production scheduling.
* Skilled in advanced Excel and Power BI, with exposure to ERP/MES and barcode or QR systems. AI or analytics knowledge is a plus.
* Analytical, detail-oriented and comfortable presenting data to senior management.
* Able to work across departments and train shop-floor teams.
